title: Reader TTS transient message long copy wraps and enlarges the overlay
symptom: A long local TTS status message shown over the reader could wrap to multiple lines and make the transient overlay taller than normal. A Pixel 8 / Android 14 Compose regression reproduced this in a 320dp-wide reader: the long message measured about 33.5dp high while a short single-line message measured about 17.5dp.
root_cause: ReaderTransientTtsMessage was themed from ReaderThemePalette after BUG-2026-032, but its text was still unconstrained. Local status messages come from controller inputs such as navigation-stop feedback, so longer explanatory copy could expand the floating overlay and obscure more reading content.
fix: Constrained ReaderTransientTtsMessage text to one line.
Rendered overflowing transient TTS message copy with TextOverflow.Ellipsis and disabled soft wrapping.
Added a full ReaderScreen Compose regression comparing a long local TTS status message against a short single-line status message at 320dp width.
failed_attempts: The existing palette trap regression for BUG-2026-032 proved the overlay used reader colors, but it did not prove long overlay copy stayed visually compact.
Testing only the controller localStatusMessage value would miss the actual overlay text wrapping behavior in ReaderScreen.
impact: Keeps temporary TTS feedback compact and reduces the chance that explanatory stop messages cover the reading surface.
